ns2:course.label: Special Topics in Design
ns2:course.description: Topics and subject matter to be published in course listings. 1 to 3 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. May be repeated as topics vary to a maximum of 9 undergraduate hours or 12 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing or consent of instructor.
